title: Scaled Late Charges on Large Microsoft 365 Annual Invoices
content:
**Scale clause.** Large Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) annual invoices carry a scaled late charge. The scale depends on the invoice's cycle charges and prorated charges added together:

- 10000.00 USD or more: the late charge is multiplied by **0.8**;
- 2500.00 USD or more, but less than 10000.00 USD: multiplied by **0.9**;
- less than 2500.00 USD: no scaling applies.

The size is the total of the cycle and prorated charges on the invoice, before any credit or payment. Late charges on the invoice are not part of that total.

## Band table

| Cycle and prorated charges on the invoice | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 2499.99 USD | no scaling |
| 2500.00 USD | 0.9 |
| 9999.99 USD | 0.9 |
| 10000.00 USD | 0.8 |
| 25000.00 USD | 0.8 |

## Hypothetical illustration

An annual invoice carries a cycle charge of 9600.00 USD and a prorated charge of 600.00 USD, a total of 10200.00. A late charge of 150.00 USD before scaling becomes 120.00 at 0.8. Had the prorated charge been absent, the total of 9600.00 would fall in the 0.9 band, and the 150.00 would become 135.00.
